decisions.reason: As a straightforward semi-hard cheese within the firm's core organic cheese competence, it still fits the established assortment, although two years without visible website support make it a borderline case.

This spicy multi-variant cheese line adds assortment complexity and sits close to the flavored cheese direction the firm already reversed, so management would likely free the resources for the core business or new development.
The mild creamy soft cheese has broader mainstream appeal and a clear role in rounding out the cheese range, which argues for retaining it despite limited recent visibility.
A washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche product in a narrow organic dairy portfolio, so it is the likeliest item to be cut in favor of more scalable core products and new projects.
